content.title: Santa Barbara in 48 Hours🌴📸 Ultimate Instagram Travel Guide
content.text: Discover why Santa Barbara is called the “American Riviera” on this PhotowalksTV adventure with Jefferson Graham. From the red-tile roofs and the historic County Courthouse, to the Mission Santa Barbara, sandy beaches, and bustling State Street, this California gem is a dream for photographers and travelers alike. ✨ Don’t just visit Santa Barbara — photowalk it! 🔔 Explore the world through our lens on PhotoWalksTV! Subscribe now for breathtaking journeys and photography tips.: / @photowalkstv Where to stay: Best Western Plus, Bath Street https://shorturl.at/avcIr This episode was filmed on multiple iPhones, a GoPro Hero 11 and DJI Mini 4 Pro.
